name: ava-companion
_retired: The companion moved into packages/web at /companion on 2026-08-03 and this package's src/ was removed with it. What is left is config, the README and COMPANION_WELLBEING_PLAN.md — kept on purpose as a record of intent, not as running code. dev/build/start pointed at a Next app that no longer exists, so `next build` failed with 'Couldn't find any pages or app directory' and took every recursive workspace build down with it. They are no-ops that explain themselves rather than deletions, so anyone running them gets told where the code went.

scripts.dev: node -e "console.log('ava-companion is retired — the companion lives in packages/web at /companion since 2026-08-03. Run the web package instead.')"
scripts.build: node -e "console.log('ava-companion: nothing to build — source retired 2026-08-03, see _retired in package.json.')"
scripts.start: node -e "console.log('ava-companion is retired — run packages/web and open /companion.')"
